name: Ray-guided volume rendering with missing brick reporting
definition: A rendering approach where each ray independently identifies the set of bricks needed for rendering and reports missing data for use in subsequent frames, ensuring optimal accuracy by never loading data that will not be used.
summary: Ray-guided volume rendering with missing brick reporting is an out-of-core technique that dynamically determines the working set during ray-casting to minimize memory bottlenecks by streaming only accessed bricks and reporting missing ones on the GPU.
